title: All-q unsigned apartment visibility kernel and spectral lift
purpose: Lift the q=3 BT546 unsigned 3-adic overlap kernel to every GQ(q,q): derive B B^T=q^4A0+q^3A1+q^2A2+qA3+A4 for unsigned flag-edge/apartment incidence, diagonalize it on the all-q flag distance scheme, and recover the exact W33 spectrum 648, 144±36sqrt6, 72, 40 with multiplicities 1,24,24,30,81.
outcomes: Derived B B^T=q^4A0+q^3A1+q^2A2+qA3+A4 from the all-q apartment pair counts.
Derived exact eigenvalues 8q^4, 2q^2(q-1)(q+1±sqrt(2q)), 2q^2(q-1)^2, and (q-1)^2(q^2+1) with primitive multiplicities 1, q(q+1)^2/2, q(q^2+1), q(q+1)^2/2, q^4.
Proved all unsigned eigenvalues are positive for q>1, so B has full row rank N=(q+1)^2(q^2+1).
Identified the signed/unsigned rank gap N-q^4=2(q+1)(q^2+1)-1 as exactly rank(D_Levi), the cut-space dimension.
Recovered the q=3 BT546 spectrum 648, 144±36sqrt6, 72, 40 and the BT549 rank split 160=81+79 exactly.
Added exact polynomial verifier, frozen certificate, cross-regressions, manuscript insert, public card source, publication-contract registration, and replay/compile workflow.
boundary: This is the spectrum of the full unsigned apartment-incidence Gram matrix and its exact rank relation to the signed Hodge matrix. It is not a contextuality-degree, quantum-code distance, or physical noise-tolerance theorem. Remote workflow success is not claimed: immediately after registration the Actions endpoint had not yet surfaced a run.
